releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.0.10 (Build 13): Critical Crash Fix & Stability Release. Resolved app force close when opening or playing songs caused by missing JNI @JvmStatic on setPreamp; wrapped native audio DSP and video surface interfaces in fail-safe try-catch handlers; eliminated potential divide-by-zero edge cases during early audio buffer feeds; guaranteed smooth crash-free playback across all tracks and Listen Together sessions.
